unit.why: An anecdote about R. Barukh of Medzhybizh hosting the author of Mayim Kedoshim on Shabbat: an exchange in which each declines to speak Torah, ending with a short teaching on humility.

stories.start_quote: ובס׳ בוצ״ד. וז״ל פ״א נתארח אצלו
stories.summary_en: On a Shabbat, R. Barukh of Medzhybizh's guest, the author of Mayim Kedoshim, refuses to speak Torah out of humility, and R. Barukh refuses too; at the third meal the guest finally teaches that the Shekhinah rests on one humble enough to fit inside the small letter yod, and R. Barukh tells him he had tried to keep a pearl from him.

tags.why: Whole episode spans the Sabbath, from Friday night to the third meal
